day_shape: 77 items: contradictory US-Iran talks signals with Trump calling Tehran 'duplicitous' and Baghaei denying contacts, CENTCOM reports 44 vessels redirected under Iran blockade, IDF eliminations of three October 7 participants, heavy Arbaeen procession coverage on regime channels.

threads.label: US-Iran talks: conflicting accounts
threads.summary: Iranian Foreign Ministry spokesperson Esmail Baghaei denied any ongoing US-Iran talks or planned meetings, while Trump called Iran's leadership 'unbelievably duplicitous'; Iran International reported backchannel negotiations resumed in Muscat after Trump suspended strikes. Iran International also reported Trump's U-turn on a planned large-scale strike has deepened political divisions inside Tehran.

threads.label: US blockade and Gulf shipping
threads.summary: CENTCOM said as of 3 August it had redirected 44 commercial vessels, disabled 2 and boarded 2 under the US blockade against Iran, while Jerusalem Post reported traffic through Bab al-Mandab and the Strait of Hormuz was largely unchanged. Six Saudi-flagged supertankers changed course in the Gulf of Aden following Houthi threats, and reports emerged of Saudi preparations for a possible operation against the Houthis.

threads.label: IDF Gaza strikes on October 7 participants
threads.summary: The IDF announced strikes killing three militants who took part in the October 7 attack: Hamas Nukhba commander Adnan Taha Abu al-Tayf and Daraj Tuffah commander Jalal Tsubeih in Gaza City, and PIJ Nukhba commander Mahmoud Fatair in Deir al-Balah. Fatair was accused of holding hostage Rom Braslavski.

threads.label: Gaza ceasefire diplomacy
threads.summary: Board of Peace Director-General Nickolay Mladenov travelled to Israel and requested all IDF strikes in Gaza stop to begin Hamas demilitarisation, while Qatar, Egypt and Turkey issued a joint statement denouncing 'ongoing Israeli violations'. UN OCHA documented over 150 Gaza fatalities in July, the highest monthly toll this year.

threads.label: Arbaeen and Khamenei messaging cycle
threads.summary: IRIB and Defa Press ran extensive coverage of Arbaeen processions across Iran, with an IRIB correspondent claiming 110,000 pilgrims returned via Mehran border since midnight and 1.25 million participating in Isfahan. Khamenei's office issued messages on 'sacred unity' and warning criminals must face consequences, and Defa Press posted Hezbollah's Naim Qassem saying the group will not abandon weapons.

threads.label: Iranian claims on US and Ukraine
threads.summary: Mohsen Rezaei, military advisor to Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei, claimed on Press TV that Iran killed hundreds of US soldiers in July strikes and had planned to strike Ukraine in retaliation for a strike on an Iranian vessel but called it off after an 'apology'. Defa Press posted a claim titled 'Collapse of US terrorist army deterrence' framing a '40-day war' as forcing a US ceasefire.

threads.label: Iran domestic pressure on Pezeshkian
threads.summary: Iran International reported a relative of Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei said Khamenei warned President Masoud Pezeshkian his next resignation would be accepted, and reported a female police colonel charged with 'disclosure of state secrets' after allegedly aiding January protesters. Iran International also reported households selling hair and renting laptops as prices stood 84% higher year-on-year despite a Central Bank claim inflation had nearly halved.

events.title: A Hamas terrorist who invaded Israel during the October 7, 2023, onslaught was killed in an airstrike in central Gaza yesterday, the IDF announces. The military says the strike in Deir al-Balah killed Abdallah Adnan Taha Abu al-Tayf, a member of Hamas's elite Nukhba Force, who invaded Israel on October 7. A separate strike in the Shati camp of Gaza City killed Jalal Tsubeih, identified by the IDF as a commander in Hamas's Daraj-Tuffah Battalion. The IDF justifies the strikes amid the ceasefire by saying both terror operatives had been advancing attacks on troops and Israeli civilians, and they were "eliminated to remove the threat."
